original_description: Search more than 18,000 ready-made map graphics from Super Map World, covering over 200 countries and the world. Find flat country maps and globe views, filter by projection, colour, and borders - including administrative levels such as regions, provinces, and counties where available. Most maps are free to download and reuse with attribution under Creative Commons and other open licences.
summary_ja: 世界や国の地図画像を投影法や色、境界などで検索。
limitations: 多くの地図は出典表記のもとで無料利用できると説明。個々のライセンスは要確認。
市街地・道路・ラベル付き地図は対象外とスキル欄に記載。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
